spans.s: Dhruva^1, one of the eight Vasus. § 116 (Vasu, pl.): I, 66, 2582, 2583 (his mother named Dhūmrā?).--§ 770 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 151, 7094 (enumeration).
Dhruva^2, son of Nahusha. § 143 (Yayāti): I, 75, 3155 (sixth son of Nahusha).
Dhruva^3, an ancient ṛshi. § 267 (Yamasabhāv.): II, 8, 321 (in the palace of Yama).

Dhruva^4, the Polar star. § 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 3, 84 (omens).--§ 641 (Rājadh.): XII, 127, 4685 (saptarshaya iva Dhruvaṃ, sc. parivārya upāviśan).--§ 707 (Mokshadh.): XII, 318, 11711 (one who fails to see Dh. has but one year to live).--§ 717b (Nārāyaṇīya): XII, 340, 12920 (jyotishāṃ śreshṭhaṃ).--§ 721 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 3, 195 (Auttānapādasya).--§ 770 (do.): XIII, 151, 7156.
Dhruva^6, a Kuru warrior. § 600 (Ghaṭotkacavadhap.): VII, 155, 6708 (slain by Bhīmasena).
Dhruva^7, a ṛshi. § 734 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 26, 1762 (among the ṛshis who came to see Bhīshma as he lay on his arrow-bed).
Dhruvadvāra, name of a place(?). § 674b (Śrī-Vāsavasaṃv.): XII, 229, 8338 (ºbhavāṃ Gaṅgāṃ).
Dhruvaka, a warrior of Skanda. § 615u (Skanda): IX, 45, 2567.
